Roadmap
01

DEPLOY $BULLEN

$BULLEN goes live. 25% of supply is held by the team, earmarked to be burned as trading grows - alongside a 1,000-piece NFT collection, minted by burning $BULLEN rather than paying SOL.

02

FIRST BLOOD

$250K in cumulative volume triggered the first burn — 12,500,000 $BULLEN, 5% of the dev-held supply, destroyed on 11 August 2026.

03

THE HOUSE FILLS UP

$1M and $5M cumulative volume trigger two more burns — 30% of dev supply burned in total.

04

FULL SPRINT

$20M cumulative volume — token price doesn't matter, market cap plays no role — 55% total dev supply up in flames.

05

THE VAULT EMPTIES

$50M cumulative volume burns the rest of the dev-held supply. 100% gone, verifiable on-chain.

06

$BULLEN STAKING

lock your $BULLEN for a set term and earn rewards paid in SOL — funded by creator fees, which keep flowing long after the dev supply is gone.

07

THE NEW WING

a second building on the grounds. it is not a page on this site. it does not sit next to what exists, it is built on top of it, and the token and the herd are load-bearing. take either one out and it does not stand. it is being built now, it is not waiting on a burn tier, and what happens inside is the largest thing this project has attempted. the doors are not open.

08

THE COLLAB

the endgame: collaborations with established fashion brands. talks TBA.

FAQ
what is $BULLEN?

a Solana token. no empty promises, no fluff you can't verify — just a monogram, a herd, and a burn schedule tied to real trading volume.

can the team mint more tokens or freeze wallets?

check the Mint Authority and Freeze Authority badges near the top of this page — they're read directly from the chain, live, every time this page loads.

how do the burns actually work?

250,000,000 was set aside at launch — 25% of the original supply. it is held in jupiter lock, not in a wallet anyone can spend from, and is excluded from circulating supply. as cumulative trading volume hits each milestone in the burn schedule above, a tier of it burns permanently — verifiable on-chain, not something we just claim happened. tier 1 fired at $250K on 11 august 2026 and destroyed 12,500,000.

what is the dev wallet used for?

the scheduled burns above, plus listings, dex updates, promotions, trending, and other services. every payment out of it is checkable on Solscan, same as the burns.

where can i verify any of this myself?

the "verify on solscan" button in the roadmap section links directly to the dev wallet. every burn, every payment, every balance change is public.

how do i actually buy it?

see the "how to buy" section above — wallet, SOL, copy the contract address, swap. four steps, easy to follow.

how do i mint one of the herd nfts?

there is no sol price. connect your wallet and burn 250,000 $BULLEN to claim a random piece from the collection — you pay only the solana network fee. every burn is permanent, same as the token burns above.

can i see the whole collection before minting?

yes — scroll up to browse all 1,000 pieces, search by name or number, and see what's already been claimed.

how do i check which pieces i own?

connect your wallet in the gallery above and switch to "my collection" — it shows exactly what you hold, live from the chain.

are some pieces rarer than others?

yes. beyond the standard trait rarity, ten pieces — five true 1-of-1s and five numbered legendaries — also carry a share of ongoing creator fee revenue. full breakdown is in the whitepaper.

is there more detail on how all of this works?

the full whitepaper covers the burn mechanics, the collection, and the fee-sharing model in one place.
